sara-docs: Noticing inconsistency: our region availability article uses the query param in all examples (`?region=eu`) but the SDK quickstart uses `X-Redwood-Region` header. Which should be the primary example? @dena-eng

dena-eng: Header-first everywhere. Backend treats header as authoritative. Keep query param in a "compatibility" callout only.

evansdk: I'll add Node + Python snippets showing header usage. Proposed Node snippet:

```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
client.setHeader('X-Redwood-Region', 'eu-central-1');
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-small', messages });
```

Is that naming ok?

tom-ops: Works for ops. Also add a one-line note about residency: region header routes compute and KV to that region; control-plane metadata may be handled according to your contract. Need legal wording for public docs.

legal-bot: legal: suggested copy for public docs: "Picking a region routes inference and short-lived compute artifacts to that region; certain control-plane records (billing, aggregated metrics) may be retained in Redwood's control plane as specified in your residency agreement." Please review internally.

sara-docs: Good — I'll place that beneath the header snippet as a caption and in the top of the region page.

dena-eng: Also add a migration note: replace `curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=eu'` with `curl -H 'X-Redwood-Region: eu' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`. Add a tiny sed example to bulk-update code samples in repos.

evansdk: Example sed for maintainers:

```bash
# replace query param examples with header examples
rg "\?region=(eu|eu-west|eu-central)" -0 --files | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/?region=\(eu[^'\" ]*\)/-H 'X-Redwood-Region: \1'/g" {}
```

tom-ops: :thumbsup: Can we add a short note that older SDK versions will still accept the query param?

dena-eng: yes, add a compatibility line and note SDK min version that supports header.

deploy-bot: docs-bot: preview for branch `docs/geo-compat-cleanup` available at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/regions (build 1234) :rocket:

sara-docs: I'll open PR with small copy edits + Node/Python snippets + migration note. tagging @evan-sdk and @miles-ux for quick review. Target: merge in next patch release.
